texts.en:
Several £blocker£ Blocker on our homeworld are preventing the construction of additional Districts, and should be cleared. This takes time and costs Resources.

To clear a Blocker, click the Clear Blocker button on the blocker itself, which can be found on the Management tab.


                                        £clear_blocker£


Blockers have different costs, technology requirements, and times associated with clearing them.
